reviews.title: I have an idea
reviews.text: Finch devs, if you’re seeing this, PLEASE make it so you can make your own custom sound mixes. Even if it’s just a Plus feature, I don’t think it should, those who don’t have it can just only make mixes out of the free soundscapes. Also in the mixes can you please make it so you can customize how loud each soundscape in the mixes are. Etc: the Cozy Cuddles sound mix. I want to make the kitty sound louder. I can hardly hear him. So as I was saying before, add custom mixes. What if I wanted a farm mix with horses and cows and chicken and sheep. Along with maybe a quiet temperate rainforest in the background. I think the app is great, but could use some quality of life updates.

reviews.title: Very nice and fun app
reviews.text: I have been on Finch for about 2 months now and I am still having fun. This app helps to keep me organized and accountable. I am able to reach goals to achieve rewards such as diamonds, clothes, and even furniture for My Finch’s home. I love being able to share reflections anytime of the day and it helps with my mood. If you are struggling with stay organized and procrastination … this is the app for you.

reviews.title: Great app, but I (still) have a problem!
reviews.text: Awesome app!!! BUTTT I’m having issues with the monthly quests! So for this recent Queen of Hearts event, i’ve been checking in and getting all my rewards on time but now it’s pushed me back and instead of me being on Day 20 and receiving awards for the 20th, the app has me on Day 18. It’s been like this since i got the app back in November. It pushes me back even when I do everything on time and it’s so unfair, i haven’t been getting all the rewards I should’ve been getting. Please, is there any way to fix this issue on my account and in general? UPDATE: that never got resolved, and now i’m having another problem 😭 I had to delete the app in order to free up storage on my phone for a software update. When I redownloaded Finch, everything seemed fine, except the app had pushed me a day back and took away a reward I had already claimed! Day 25 of August’s Game On! The Gamer Den PC decor. I already had it in color Sweet! My last reward is supposed to be on Day 27. Please, can you put it back on my account? This isn’t the first time this has happened unfortunately.

reviews.title: finch fanatic
reviews.text: it’s cute, it’s fun, & it def helps me organize & build healthy habits which i love! my only complaint is i wish it would let us decorate more space because the space is very limited and after getting mostly everything you want it can become boring. i hope the creators try to find new ways of keeping their users entertained like games or in app messaging etc which would help users want to interact with the app more.
